spinner.name: Spinner
spinner.purpose: Indicate compact indeterminate loading without implying progress value or reserving content structure.

anatomy.rule: SVG circular track sized by density context.
A single semantic SVG stroke shows active loading without becoming status resolution.
Names loading when the spinner stands alone.
Continuous rotation plus a breathing SVG arc communicates waiting rhythm and respects reduced motion.

intents.description: Subtle loading inside dense or neutral controls.
High-risk waiting context owned by the parent state.

Energy.decision: Use Energy for active ring tone and inactive border.
Energy.behavior: Spinner remains readable against Design System surfaces.

Voice.decision: Use Voice for standalone loading labels.
Voice.behavior: Loading is named when it is not decorative.

Frame.decision: Use Frame for ring size and border width.
Frame.behavior: Spinner fits field, button, and inline contexts.
Frame.example: Small spinner in Input trailing slot.
Frame.rejectIf: Size uses arbitrary pixels outside contract.

Momentum.decision: Use Momentum for compact spin plus arc breathing and reduced motion.
Momentum.behavior: Motion communicates waiting through arc growth and release, without scale jitter or uneven acceleration.
Momentum.test: Verify spin keyframes, arc breathing keyframes, and reduced motion.

Accessibility.decision: Use role status for standalone loading and aria-hidden for decorative slots.
Accessibility.behavior: Spinner announces only when it owns the loading message.
Accessibility.example: Button loading uses decorative spinner plus button label.

Depth.decision: Use Depth only through the owning control or surface.
Depth.behavior: Spinner remains inline and does not create a layer.
Depth.example: Button loading spinner inside a button.
Depth.rejectIf: Spinner floats independently as an overlay.

State.decision: Use State for loading ownership only.
State.behavior: Spinner represents loading and owner handles disabled, error, success, and recovery.
State.rejectIf: Spinner owns completion or error state.

Tone.decision: Use Tone for concise loading labels.
Tone.behavior: Standalone label names the wait without blame.
Tone.rejectIf: Copy is vague or absent when standalone.

Growth.decision: Use Growth to escalate larger loading flows to patterns.
Growth.example: Full page hydration uses Skeleton or a loading pattern instead.

Symbol.decision: Spinner is the loading symbol and should not add extra icon meaning.
Symbol.rejectIf: Spinner is paired with decorative status icons that change meaning.

Iconography.decision: Use Iconography scale only through density; do not replace Spinner with a glyph.
Iconography.behavior: Inputs and selects consume Spinner instead of a spinning icon glyph.
Iconography.rejectIf: A custom loading glyph spins instead of Spinner.

productExamples.example: Async validation in trailing field slot.
Saving action while button is disabled.

do: Use Spinner for compact unknown loading.
Use decorative mode inside labeled loading controls.
Use Progress Indicator when value is known and Skeleton when content structure is loading.
dont: Do not use Spinner as a full-page loading strategy.
Do not replace error, empty, or recovery content with Spinner.
info: Owner component controls disabled, retry, recovery, and completion states.

props.name: label
props.notes: Accessible loading label when Spinner stands alone.

props.name: density
props.notes: Compact, default, and prominent density mapping.

props.name: state
props.notes: Reflects loading ownership and accessibility mode; owner handles completion and recovery.

props.name: decorative
props.notes: Hide from assistive technology when the owning component already announces loading.

tests: Input and Select loading consume Spinner
rejectIf: Spinner is used for measurable progress.
A control draws a custom spinning icon instead of Spinner.
Spinner replaces Skeleton for structured content loading.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: dense filters, table controls, and compact status

agentInstructions: Use Spinner for compact unknown-duration loading only.
Use decorative mode inside a labeled loading owner such as Button, Input, or Select.
Ask when the wait needs progress value, content placeholder structure, recovery, retry, cancellation, or page-level orchestration.
